impact.rule: the most severe impact class with probability >= floor; 0.3 because a miss (understated severity) costs more than a false action (an extra owner report)

local_only.rule: lowers the level only at >= 0.7: wrongly lowering costs more than escalating

reached.rule: treated as unreached only at P(reached) <= 0.3 (P(unreached) >= 0.7)

minimums.reason: assumed per jev-actions: the owner gave none; recall raised to 0.9 because a missed high/critical costs more than an extra owner report

label_set.provenance: agent_reviewed (author session and an independent blind session agreed on 150 of 150 labels)
label_set.split: all dev; no test set yet

results.v1: first wording: rubric severity matched labels on 24/30; 4 understated (reached scored 0.27-0.30 on true hits: C01, C09, C11; C30 impact), 2 overstated
results.current: after rewording reached and local_only: 27/30 match the policy severity (C30, a malicious package, is now routed critical to the owner by the deterministic MAL- rule before judge() and counts as a match), 0 understated, 3 overstated (C08 unclear round-up, C13, C15 reached on non-vulnerable use); halt decision (owner vs in-flow fix) matched 28/30
results.calibration: tune_threshold.py --calibration --repeats 5 --conservative: no threshold met the minimums in any fold (too few positives); Brier raw local_only 0.034, needs_interaction 0.083, reached 0.066; Platt improved only needs_interaction (0.017) and cannot be confirmed without a test set, so raw is kept; needs_privileges has no positive case
results.malicious_rule: C30 (eslint-scope 3.7.2, alias MAL-GHSA-hxxf-q3w9-4xgw) never reaches the judgment: workflows.malicious_package routes it as critical to the owner. Its Jev scores in scores.csv were taken before the MAL- alias was added to its state; the judgment had read it as data_exposure (dev high -> medium, the only understatement)

todo: provisional: grow to about 30 human-reviewed cases per label (needs_privileges positives, local_only positives), build a test set from a newer replay window, then tune and recheck calibration; probabilities are not fit to show as confidence
